description: Click the conservation patches on the current window to inspect the hidden glass pieces; each exposed piece stays visible when it moves. Restore the thirteen glass pieces to the reference. Start the collars. A disc may turn only when it contains the heart and no foreign point. Turn while its moving notch straddles the fixed brass pin. Turning a free disc against a closed collar cracks the window and ends the episode. Shape-blocked probes are harmless. Collars keep moving during dragging and holding. Seal only the restored window. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in this task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network or source inspection, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or other hidden-state access. Do not switch to unrelated, blank, pre-existing, or browser-settings tabs.
